source: Armagedom origin/main Web/public/assets/dog/original-dog.glb (25-joint skin: root > pelvis > spine > chest > neck > head > jaw > bite_tip, head > ear_L/ear_R; pelvis > tail_1 > tail_2 > tail_3; pelvis > leg_B[LR] > shin > paw; chest > leg_F[LR] > shin > paw). World rest position of every joint, from the GLB node JSON only (full translation + rotation + scale composed down the parents, no mesh read; the leg nodes are rotated, so translations alone would be wrong). The two armature nodes above root are not bones and carry no offset. Model units, before the model scale the game applies (data/bodies/dog.chain.json scale). The creature faces +z, stands on y = 0, its spine runs along z. Left is -x here (leg_BL x -0.074).
units: glb model units (metres before the game's model scale)

bbox_model_units.source: extent of the bone points only (paw_BL x -0.09, ear tip y 0.427, tail_3 z -0.472 to bite_tip z 0.391), not the mesh
